description: This file defines React components for a navigation menu UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling. It includes components like NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, and related trigger, content, viewport, link, and indicator components, with styling and behavior for a dropdown navigation menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main navigation menu component that optionally includes a viewport.

methods.name: NavigationMenuList
methods.description: Component for the list container within the navigation menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual navigation item.

methods.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button that opens the menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content of the menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuViewport
methods.description: Component for the viewport area of the dropdown menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuLink
methods.description: Component for links within the menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuIndicator
methods.description: Component for the indicator element in the menu.
